calibration.provenance: gold-human-v1: question-level Platt scaling over the top reranked score of the 30 hand-authored gold questions (24 answerable, 6 unanswerable); the threshold maximises balanced accuracy. Coefficients and threshold are refitted on all 30, so the reported in-sample balanced accuracy is optimistic; held_out records the id-parity split measured out of sample.
